## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and removed unrelated changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and the changelog.
- [ ] Build, lint, and tests pass for affected packages.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, tokens, personal data, or generated `dist` output.
- [ ] Breaking changes include compatibility impact and migration instructions.
